ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( EYI_IsAutomationBypassed__c = false, ISPICKVAL(EYI_Status__c, "Loan Closed"), AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(EYI_Closure_Reason__c)), EYI_Active__c = true ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Status is 'Loan Closed', Closure Reason is required and Active must be unchecked.
